name: SurrounDead - Last Signal Dedicated Server
author: amberger.fabio@gmail.com
description: Dedicated SurrounDead server with the Last Signal mod. Runs the Windows build under Wine without graphics or sound (-nullrhi). Players join from the in-game server list (Last Signal client mod required).
startup: for P in LastSignal-Server.tar.gz NetTest-Server.tar.gz; do if [ -f $P ]; then tar -xzf $P && rm -f $P; fi; done; if [ -f start.sh ]; then exec bash ./start.sh; else echo "Last Signal not installed: upload LastSignal-Server.tar.gz via SFTP, then start again."; fi

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Installs SurrounDead (Windows build, branch STEAM_BETA, default experimental = 0.8 / UE 5.6) via SteamCMD and unpacks the Last Signal server package.
# Without a Steam login: upload the game files via SFTP (SurrounDead/ and Engine/ from your own install).
set -e
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq curl ca-certificates lib32gcc-s1 tar >/dev/null
mkdir -p /mnt/server /mnt/server/saves
cd /mnt/server

if [ -n "${STEAM_USER}" ]; then
    mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
    curl -sSL https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
    /mnt/server/steamcmd/steamcmd.sh +@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +force_install_dir /mnt/server \
        +login "${STEAM_USER}" "${STEAM_PASS}" ${STEAM_AUTH} +app_update 1645820 ${STEAM_BETA:+-beta ${STEAM_BETA}} validate +quit
    rm -rf /mnt/server/steamcmd /root/Steam
else
    echo "No Steam login set: upload the SurrounDead game files via SFTP."
fi

if [ -n "${LASTSIGNAL_URL}" ]; then
    curl -fsSL -o /mnt/server/LastSignal-Server.tar.gz "${LASTSIGNAL_URL}"
fi
if [ -f /mnt/server/LastSignal-Server.tar.gz ]; then
    tar -xzf /mnt/server/LastSignal-Server.tar.gz -C /mnt/server && rm -f /mnt/server/LastSignal-Server.tar.gz
elif [ ! -f /mnt/server/start.sh ]; then
    echo "Last Signal not installed yet: upload LastSignal-Server.tar.gz via SFTP, then start the server."
fi
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/server.cfg ] && [ -f /mnt/server/server.cfg.example ]; then
    cp /mnt/server/server.cfg.example /mnt/server/server.cfg
fi
echo "Installation complete."

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name shown in the in-game server list.

variables.name: Server Description
variables.description: Short description shown in the in-game server list (max 120 characters).

variables.name: Message of the Day
variables.description: Welcome message shown in chat when a player joins. Empty = none.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Players need this password to join. Empty = open server. The server list only shows a lock, the password is never sent to it.

variables.name: Public Server
variables.description: 1 = show the server in the in-game server list, 0 = hidden.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: How many players can be online at the same time (1-64).

variables.name: Admins (Player IDs)
variables.description: Player IDs of the admins, comma-separated. Every player sees their own ID in game under J > SERVER (console: "players"). Admins get the ADMIN tab in the journal. Optional entries steam:<17 digits>: once one is listed, an admin needs a listed ID and a listed Steam ID.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Optional. If set, admins (IDs above) get their admin rights only after typing "/admin <password>" in chat, once per connection (5 tries). Empty = admin by ID alone.

variables.name: Server FPS
variables.description: Target updates per second while players are online (20-120). The server lowers it by itself when the machine cannot keep up. Without players it idles at 5.

variables.name: Server FPS Minimum
variables.description: Lowest target the automatic FPS throttle may choose under load (20-120, at most Server FPS). Steps: 50, 45, 40, 30, 20.

variables.name: FPS Automatic
variables.description: 1 = the server lowers its FPS by itself when it cannot keep up (not below Server FPS Minimum) and raises it again when it has headroom. 0 = fixed Server FPS. Console: fps auto on/off.

variables.name: Autosave (minutes)
variables.description: How often the world is saved, in minutes. Players are additionally saved every 10 seconds.

variables.name: Save Slot
variables.description: Name of the save folder in saves/ (e.g. MyWorld). Empty = most recently played save.

variables.name: Corpse Cleanup (minutes)
variables.description: Dead zombies disappear after this many minutes, including unlooted items. Also applies to items the server sets down at a player's feet (give, consumed items) and, only with srv_drophook_first=1 in coop.txt, to items players drop (detected fresh within 6 m of a player). Never while a player is within 15 m. 0 = never.

variables.name: Death Box Cleanup (minutes)
variables.description: Player death boxes disappear after this many minutes, including their contents (never while a player is nearby). 0 = never.

variables.name: Loot Refill
variables.description: 1 = searched loot containers refill after the refill time, like in single player (Difficulty.Refill). 0 = never. Overrides the value from the save.

variables.name: Loot Refill Time (minutes)
variables.description: Minutes until a searched loot container refills (Difficulty.RefillTime, 1-10080).

variables.name: Save Backups (count)
variables.description: Number of save backups kept in saves/_backup (made at server start after a clean stop and after a world save, see Backup Interval). 0 = no backups.

variables.name: Backup Interval (minutes)
variables.description: At most one save backup per this many minutes while the server runs (taken right after a completed world save). 0 = only at server start after a clean stop (a server that never stops cleanly then gets no new backups).

variables.name: Daily Restart (HH:MM)
variables.description: Daily restart at this time of the container (often UTC). Players are warned 10, 5 and 1 minute and 30 s before, then the server saves and stops; Wings must start it again (crash detection with 'detect clean exit as crash', both on by default). Never within the first hour after a start. Empty = off.

variables.name: Bring Own Inventory
variables.description: 1 = players bring their own local save (like Valheim). 0 = inventories stay on the server (default).

variables.name: Master List URL
variables.description: Server list the server announces itself to. Only change this if you run your own master list. Empty = not listed.

variables.name: Master List Key
variables.description: Only for a private master list that requires a key. The public server list needs none. Empty = no key.

variables.name: Public Address
variables.description: Address players connect to (IP or domain). Empty = IP of the allocation.

variables.name: Steam Username
variables.description: Steam account that owns SurrounDead (only used to download the game during installation). You can leave it empty and upload the game files via SFTP instead.

variables.name: Steam Password
variables.description: Only used for the download during installation.

variables.name: Steam Guard Code
variables.description: Current Steam Guard code if Steam asks for one (enter it right before reinstalling).

variables.name: Last Signal Package URL
variables.description: Optional download link for LastSignal-Server.tar.gz. Empty = upload the file via SFTP and restart the server.

variables.name: Wine Packages
variables.description: Runtime libraries for Unreal Engine and UE4SS.

variables.name: Virtual Display
variables.description: Wine needs a display even without graphics.

variables.name: Steam branch
variables.description: SteamCMD beta branch of SurrounDead. Last Signal 0.10 needs "experimental" (0.8, UE 5.6). Empty = stable branch (not supported).
